source.content: Schema.DescribeSObjectResult describe = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe(); Map<String, Schema.RecordTypeInfo> byDeveloperName = describe.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName(); Map<Id, Schema.RecordTypeInfo> byId = describe.getRecordTypeInfosById(); Map<String, Schema.RecordTypeInfo> byName = describe.getRecordTypeInfosByName(); System.assert(byDeveloperName.size() >= 2); System.assert(byId.size() >= 2); System.assert(byName.containsKey('Business Account')); Schema.RecordTypeInfo business = byDeveloperName.get('Business'); System.assertNotEquals(null, business); System.assertEquals('Business', business.getDeveloperName()); System.assertEquals(business.getDeveloperName(), business.developerName); System.assertNotEquals(null, business.getRecordTypeId()); System.assertEquals(business.getRecordTypeId(), business.recordTypeId); System.assert(business.isActive()); System.assert(business.isAvailable()); System.assert(!business.isDefaultRecordTypeMapping()); System.assert(!business.isMaster()); Schema.DescribeFieldResult parent = Account.Parent__c.getDescribe(); Schema.FilteredLookupInfo lookup = parent.getFilteredLookupInfo(); System.assertNotEquals(null, lookup);
